title: Podcast Scraper — Pipeline stages (RFC-109)
description: Per-episode processing manifest signal. Requires JSON log lines with event_type=pipeline_stage (RFC-109 / ADR-130), emitted per stage from processing_manifest.update_stage. Correlate by run_id / episode_id.

targets.expr: sum by (stage) (sum_over_time({env="prod"} | json | event_type="pipeline_stage" | unwrap cost_usd [30d]))
sum by (run_id) (sum_over_time({env="prod"} | json | event_type="pipeline_stage" | unwrap cost_usd [30d]))
sum by (stage) (sum_over_time({env="prod"} | json | event_type="pipeline_stage" | unwrap duration_s [7d]))

panels.title: Method-version inventory (reprocess key) — episodes per stage×version
panels.description: Which stage logic produced how many episodes. After shipping an improvement, the rows below the new method_version are exactly the set to reprocess (ADR-130 §Convention 2).

panels.title: Flagged stage-writes (24h)
panels.description: Stage writes carrying a rework quality_flag (asr_failover / unnamed_dominant_voice / empty_host_anchor / guest_in_title_not_placed / gi_all_gated / asr_speech_coverage_low).

panels.title: Recent flagged episodes
